Normalization: This is a selected workflow projection of owned native AWS SDK probes, replayed through the existing real-SDK integration harness on memory and SQLite stores. Queue URLs alone are rebound to the local public endpoint by ebTargetRoleReplay.call.

Receipt selection merges ALL captures by body.replay-name plus body.detail.marker (and queue), never by polling label. The one-day-retention receipt and around-edge receipt are in the main capture despite empty supplemental polling windows.

AWS-generated event IDs remain distinct symbolic identities bound to local PutEvents IDs or first replay receipts. Fan-out shares an occurrence ID; every replay must create new IDs. Queue transport IDs, receive timestamps and polling labels are evidence only, not event envelope fields.

Accounts, resource names, customer event timestamps, detail (including null and nested fields), resource arrays, source, type, region and replay-name are unchanged. The live-control call with no customer timestamp is pinned to its captured receipt timestamp.

Manual local clock starts after native customer event times. Immediate STARTING and CANCELLING are observable while frozen; 60-second advance plus job drain settles replay, one-second advance settles cancellation. These are deterministic local scheduling choices, not claims about exact measured AWS latency. Native ReplayStartTime/ReplayEndTime are normalized to lifecycle presence and ordering.

Captured whole-minute EventLastReplayedTime compares exactly as an instant, even when no event lies in the exact [EventStartTime,EventEndTime) delivery window or a destination rule filters/blocks all deliveries.

Native archive counters before/after replay are retained as evidence. EventCount is asserted; SizeBytes=888 is NOT asserted as a specified AWS encoding. Counts remain four after repeated replays, including one ingested event with a customer timestamp two days older than one-day retention.

Source deletion follows the independent empty-archive STARTING probe, which later reports FAILED. Completed/cancelled replay history is checked after source archive deletion using the postcleanup native ListReplays projection. Exact 90-day history expiry is not measured in these captures.
